name: Save 2B Young Man
summary:
The protagonist originally set out to buy a ticket to escape the apocalypse, but instead accidentally ended up saving the world…!

This game was an entry in 6R’s 2012 “End of the World” themed contest.

Throughout the game, you’ll encounter well-known internet figures such as Chun Ge, Zeng Ge, Sister Feng, and Sister Furong — making it very much a “meme throwback” experience.

Gameplay follows the style of a traditional RPG: control your character with the keyboard, explore houses, palaces, and item shops. In shops you can purchase items and equipment, while each character also possesses unique skills such as healing, revival, and curing poison. Characters grow stronger as they level up, enhancing their abilities over time.
